runtime_gate.reason: Existing canonical F-host shared-runner heartbeat remains stale and height_difference_2 guarded operator recovery remains unexecuted.

score_basis: Candidate-specific reconciliation across the authoritative Brownfield entity, adopted LBBD plan status, LBBD Regulation 19 allocation records, adjacent Planning Committee case and current conservation-area guidance; allocation and adjacency are explicitly prevented from becoming a synthetic permission.

sources.label: Planning Data LBBD64/XE
sources.fact: Ibscott Close Estate is LBBD64/XE, 4.2ha, publicly owned, minimum 658 and maximum 831 net dwellings, planning-permission-status not-permissioned.

sources.label: Planning Data XE geometry semantics
sources.fact: XE supplies point POINT (0.164384 51.539473) but blank geometry; the point is not treated as the allocation/red-line/title polygon.

sources.label: LBBD Local Plan 2037
sources.fact: LBBD Local Plan 2037 was adopted on 18 September 2024 and is the starting point for decision-making.

sources.label: LBBD Local Plan allocation framework
sources.fact: The adopted plan includes Appendix 2 Site Allocation Proformas, but allocation status is planning-policy evidence rather than permission or title evidence.

sources.label: LBBD Development Plan
sources.fact: The current Development Plan includes the adopted LBBD 2037 Local Plan and London Plan 2021; development-plan inclusion does not itself grant permission.

sources.label: LBBD Regulation 19 decision record
sources.fact: The Council's Regulation 19 decision record explicitly lists XE - Ibscott Close Estate among site-allocation documents, confirming allocation provenance rather than a planning application.

sources.label: LBBD Regulation 19 agenda item
sources.fact: The Regulation 19 agenda item separately lists XE Ibscott Close Estate and other allocation attachments; allocation references are not application references.

sources.label: LBBD The Bull adjacent application
sources.fact: The Bull Inn, Rainham Road South is exact application 23/01494/FULL for 72 residential units; it is a separate adjacent planning case.

sources.label: The Bull impact on Ibscott
sources.fact: Committee assessment explicitly considered sunlight/daylight impact on Ibscott Close, demonstrating adjacency/context but not a permission for the wider Ibscott allocation.

sources.label: The Bull committee resolution
sources.fact: Committee delegated grant for The Bull subject to section 106 and conditions; that resolution is confined to the Bull Inn application site.

sources.label: LBBD conservation areas
sources.fact: LBBD identifies Dagenham Village as a conservation area context with statutory control and mapped boundaries; exact candidate intersection requires polygon overlay.

sources.label: LBBD conservation design guidance
sources.fact: Development affecting conservation areas can require high design standards and evidence; borough/village proximity alone is not converted into an exact parcel heritage constraint.

examples.result: XE remains not-permissioned in the authoritative Brownfield record despite being an allocated regeneration site.
658-831 net dwellings is an allocation/brownfield capacity range, not a consented-unit range.
Regulation 19 and adopted-plan allocation provenance is not converted into a planning application reference.
The Bull 23/01494/FULL is a separate adjacent 72-home case and is not attached to the wider XE site.
The Bull's assessment of sunlight/daylight effects on Ibscott proves adjacency only.
Dagenham Village conservation-area context requires exact boundary intersection before parcel-level constraint scoring.
XE blank geometry is not replaced with its point, The Bull red-line, conservation-area map, or a nearest polygon.
Promotion remains zero until an exact current XE planning case, exact site/title polygon and current statutory overlays are verified.
